name: Ohanes (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally by a narrow white stripe from the upper hoist to the lower fly, purple above and green below, charged at the centre with a scroll inscribed VILLA DE OHANES bearing the municipal arms.
history: Municipal flag of Ohanes; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Ohanes arms on a scroll inscribed VILLA DE OHANES
